target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
focus: case lifecycle lock to catalog lock ordering and deadlock risk
catalog chain reread, generation allocation, append, and Sync atomicity window
zero-byte cleanup_quarantined failure and restart recovery
summary: The SDD gives a coherent cross-process catalog serialization protocol: under an OS exclusive lock tied to the verified handle, writers reread and validate the chain, allocate the next generation, append one complete frame, Flush+Sync, and only then acknowledge; snapshots use the same lock. The sole nested order is case lifecycle lock then catalog lock, and catalog-lock holders must not acquire/wait for case locks. The bounded critical section excludes DB, deletion, Planner/Registry, and network/model work, so no lock-order cycle is apparent. Cleanup remains fail-closed before durable quarantine; zero-byte failure leaves the valid old chain authoritative for safe restart revalidation/retry, while partial or uncertain tails globally fail closed. No security blocker was found in the written design.

control_dispositions.cross_process_catalog_serialization: coherent if every catalog reader/writer honors the specified OS lock; runtime primitive not tested
control_dispositions.lock_order_deadlock: no cycle under case-before-catalog order and prohibition on acquiring case lock while holding catalog lock
control_dispositions.append_atomicity_window: chain reread, generation allocation, complete-frame append, and Sync are serialized as one critical section; readers use same lock
control_dispositions.zero_byte_cleanup_append_failure: no deletion; current supervisor fails closed; a fully valid old chain remains authoritative after restart for revalidation/retry
control_dispositions.partial_or_uncertain_append_failure: global fail closed without rollback to old state
control_dispositions.acceptance_matrix: covers cross-case parallel append and cleanup failure branches; explicit lock-acquisition-failure and owner-process-death/progress cases recommended

recommendations: Add deterministic acceptance coverage for OS lock acquisition failure and process termination while holding the lock.
Assert no catalog operation proceeds without exclusive ownership, lock recovery after owner exit, and bounded completion under simultaneous contention.
Fail closed if the filesystem/platform cannot provide the specified cross-process exclusive lock; do not fall back to an in-process mutex.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No lock primitive, Sync durability, process-crash recovery, contention timing, or catalog fault injection was exercised.
Approval is limited to the written test-only design under its declared trusted-local-account boundary; it does not establish implementation correctness, production readiness, or classroom readiness.
